zh.title: 标准化跨端安全配对
items: 浏览器和 Android 的新设备配对已切换到 RFC 9382 SPAKE2-P256-SHA256-HKDF-HMAC，8 位连接码仍只留在两端设备。
Web、Android 与电脑端现在使用一致的 transcript、HKDF 和双向 HMAC 确认；错误连接码会在保存内容密钥前被拒绝。
现有已授权设备可继续使用；新设备配对需要使用本版本的 Web、Server、Android 与电脑端协议实现。

en.title: Standardized secure pairing across devices
items: New browser and Android device pairing now uses RFC 9382 SPAKE2-P256-SHA256-HKDF-HMAC, while the eight-character connection code remains only on the two endpoints.
Web, Android, and desktop now share the same transcript, HKDF, and bidirectional HMAC confirmation flow; incorrect codes are rejected before a content key is stored.
Existing authorized devices continue to work; new pairings require this version of the Web, Server, Android, and desktop protocol implementation.
